frames.name: 01 Build map
frames.html:
Build map

A free desktop app. Build it in a new repo, with these screens in this look. Useful Apply stays as it is, as the legacy product. Backend and order of work are in the plan, saved in the Useful Apply repo.

Screens

ScreenFramesOld part
First runN1, N2, F1, F2, G1, G3GuidedLine, GuidedStepper
TodayA1, A5b, A6, T1, T3, T4ChatGreeting, suggested prompts, empty workspace
JobsA2, G3, G5, G7FeedCanvas, FeedConversation, FeedJobCard, FeedEditView
Job page, with the fit on itJ1, J3, F8FeedJobDetail, DecisionChips
ApplicationsA7, A8, P6, P8TrackerCanvas, StatusPopover, TrackerConversation, Sidebar
One application: papersA4, A5, A9, D1, D2, D3, D5, D6, D10AppShell, CanvasColumn, CVPanel, CoverLetterPanel, EmailPanel, EditableCVCanvas, ATSChangesView, AnswersPanel
One application: after sendingP1, P2, P3, P4, P7ApplicationHeader, DeleteConfirm
Ask panel, on every screenK1, K2, K5ConversationColumn, ChatPanel interface
Settings, one pageS1, S6SettingsModal and its panes
Error pageU7error.tsx

Today shows the first match

  1. Interview today or tomorrow
  2. Offer deadline close
  3. Check-in overdue
  4. Application ready to send
  5. A paper failed
  6. Writing in progress
  7. Check-in due this week
  8. Good jobs already picked
  9. New jobs waiting: offer to pick
  10. No search set up: show my plan
  11. No CV: first run

Rules

  • No tutorial. Anyone can pick it up straight away.
  • Every page has one primary button.
  • The app decides what's next. The agent runs only when asked.
  • Scanning is free and runs by itself. Picking and scoring ask first.
  • The user sends. The agent never does.
  • Chat is a side panel. It never covers the page you're asking about.
  • Not for me acts at once, with Undo.
  • Edit on the paper. The letter works like the CV in D6, and job details edit in place.
  • Ask for start date and pay only when the ad needs them (F8).
  • Mac app. Installs with one Terminal command, with no Apple signing, like Useful Bot.
  • English interface, German documents first.
  • Light mode only. Navy acts, gold marks.
  • Parts are in 02. The connections are in 03. First run is in 04. Chat is in 05.
  • All names and numbers here are examples.

How the side panel behaves

Budget Lead, Halden Gruppe. We're looking for...
That looks like a job ad. I'd check the fit first.

PlaceWhat happens

frames.name: 04 First run flow
frames.html:
First run flow

The agent reads the CV, so the agent comes first.

Step 1

Your agent

N1

Finds Claude Code and Codex. Continue sends a small test message.

Step 2

Your CV

F1, F2

The agent reads the CV and builds the base CV.

Step 3

Your search

G1

Titles and places come from the CV. One question: pick jobs on its own? Off by default.

Then

First scan

G3

Free, and uses no agent. The full app opens here.

Done

Jobs

A2

With picking off, it offers Pick the best for me first (G7).

When something's off

What happensWhat the user seesThen
No agent foundN2: one click sets up Claude Code or CodexSign in, test, step 2
Signed outN1 and N2: Sign in opens the browserTest, step 2
Out of dateN2: update it, or use our copyTest, step 2
Test message failsN2: Try again, or use the other agentStep 2 once a test passes
CV can't be readN2: try another file, or paste the textStep 3
Usage limit while readingK5: use the other agent, or waitCarries on with step 2
Skip for nowG5: the user types titles and places. Scanning and the job list work. Reading the CV, picking and writing don'tConnect later from Settings (S1) or Ask (K5), then step 2
